posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
It seems my prediction about this month's episodes was almost accurate except for having the Contest instead of Sky-Sky. Which makes me sad because I've been so much wanting to know more about Sky-Sky.

On the other hand I've also been wanting to know about the whole deal about everybody being gladiators, so I can only half complain...

And I admit I almost feel sorry for Biomancer now on his major weakness thing. Almost. Just a tiny bit. And now am even more eager for the RPG corebooks to finally be a thing.

And I actually do legitimately feel sorry for him on the whole "innate talent" bit, since I can actually relate to that gripe/resentment. C&A seem to have the same outlook I do that talent is more important to everything people can do than actual training, and it's always been a source of upset for me that I seem to have literally no innate talents whatsoever and while I'm good at thinking/learning that's still never been able to get me as better than mediocre at anything as a result.

It reminds me of me and my best friend when it comes to music, actually. He has an inborn knack for things like hearing pitches that I don't, so I'm merely decent at singing after years of formal study while he's extremely good at basically everything musical after mainly just teaching himself, so I always kinda resented him a little for that. Anyhoo.

Maybe Biomancer's obsession with perfecting and copying nature is fueled partly by that; a sort of "take that!" at everyone who was born with abilities he can only try to replicate.

Chokepoint being an Omega is somehow both unexpected and yet not a surprise at the same time.

The "is there comics in the Sentinels Universe" question was kind of amusing to me since in the Marvel universe there explicitly is comics that feature the "real life" heroes, as well as movies based on said heroes and gossip/celebrity mags that feature heroes.

*rimshot*

 

Honestly, talent is really just a better starting point than no talent.  All the talent in the world is useless if you don't use it.  

 

I don't have any real talent for cooking, but I've gotten pretty good at cooking since I started actually doing so and trying new things. (no inedible meals yet!)

 

My natural physical gifts are modest at best, but I'm a Green Glove in Savate with less than a year of training, and aiming for Red Glove (and the ability to compete) soon, probably early next year.

Love ya Devra, but please don't develop either a god complex or a "replace all flesh with superior metal" comples.

 

 

And I agree with Jeysie, Choke being an Omega is somehow not terribly surprising. Though there wasn't mention of a water related incident in discussions of her origin.
